label: Fixed-content calibration and actual access yield divine assent accuracy
description: Re-presentation of divine assent accuracy, not independent support for it (#2103). Keep the content, its supplied world interpretation, its report, and the bearer fixed within the application. The calibration links the actual legacy assent to a content assented under the supplied relation and then to its box. The actual edge gives the content's truth at actuality. Disquotation and the matching report recover the original proposition. The content type, interpretation, report and assent relation are theorem parameters absent from the conclusion and pinned by no record. For any context with actual access, some choice of them satisfies the calibration exactly when 7dd8a624 holds (Lean fixedContentRepresentationIff), the defect unrestrictedRepresentationIff diagnoses for the superseded interface. The argument adds warrant only if those parameters are fixed by an independently interpreted content theory and an assent relation independent of the legacy assent. Its restates_conclusion marker (#2190) makes the frontier close 7dd8a624 through it only by rule (d), when every premise is closed.

restates_conclusion.note: For a fixed context with actual access aba394e1 (held fixed as a hypothesis of the lemma), some content type, interpretation, report and assent relation satisfy the fixed-content calibration 104b8748 exactly when 7dd8a624 holds; the witness is disquotational. The calibration therefore re-presents divine assent accuracy unless those parameters are fixed independently.
